# CULUA Fan Archive (Unofficial)

> An unofficial fan site for CULUA (カルア), with a searchable performance archive and official-source updates for CULUA, NEUN (ノイン), and MEDA (メダ).

- [Song archive](https://culuasonglist.netlify.app/songs): Fan-maintained song records, timestamped official YouTube playback, artist categories, and statistics.
- [Original music](https://culuasonglist.netlify.app/discography): CULUA releases and MV links synced from RK Music, TuneCore, and the official YouTube channel feed.
- [News](https://culuasonglist.netlify.app/news): Source-linked official cohort announcements.
- [Timeline](https://culuasonglist.netlify.app/timeline): Cohort concerts, official events, and release dates.
- [Fan creations](https://culuasonglist.netlify.app/fanart): Curated X posts credited through original embeds.
- [About](https://culuasonglist.netlify.app/about): Sources and unofficial-site identity.

Content is revalidated on demand after a 30-minute cache interval. Song records are curated by fans, not extracted automatically from videos. Follow source links for authoritative announcements. The archive does not claim completeness, official affiliation, or a fixed number of songs.
